pages: Mika, a boy of nine, black hair cut in a straight line round his ears, a green duffle coat with sleeves turned back, draws a straw broom across the concrete round a white stone pillar by the office door. Middle distance: the sundial's dark gnomon, drifted chalk dust. Background: the school wall, a low white sun. Hard blue shadow.

Mr Raukura, a grey-haired man of sixty-five in a dark suit, holds one handbell up beside the school steps, stopped for a moment. Middle distance: a round white clock with two hands, the white stone pillar and its sundial. Background: bare trees, low winter sun across the gravel. Cold clear daylight.

Mika, a boy of nine, black hair cut in a straight line round his ears, a green duffle coat with sleeves turned back, crouches and presses one stub of blue chalk to the end of a shadow. Middle distance: a broom handle upright into the ground, blue marks. Background: the white pillar, the school wall, low sun. Hard blue shadow.

Mika, a boy of nine, black hair cut in a straight line round his ears, a green duffle coat with sleeves turned back, kneels with one palm flat on the concrete beside a row of blue chalk marks. Middle distance: the broom handle in the ground, its long shadow, grit. Background: the yard wall, flat noon sun. Hard shadow.

Mika, a boy of nine, black hair cut in a straight line round his ears, a green duffle coat with sleeves turned back, walks the concrete with one yellow tape measure held out in both hands. Middle distance: the broom handle driven into the ground, its long shadow, the pillar. Background: the school wall, low white sun. Cold daylight.

Mika, a boy of nine, black hair cut in a straight line round his ears, a green duffle coat with sleeves turned back, stands hands behind his back beside one taut string run out from the broom handle. Middle distance: the handle, the string pegged at its end, the shadow tip. Background: the white pillar, noon sun. Hard blue shadow.

Mika, a boy of nine, black hair cut in a straight line round his ears, a green duffle coat with sleeves turned back, crouches low, his eye near the concrete, watching the shadow tip lie along one taut string. Middle distance: the broom handle, a wooden peg, scored chalk. Background: the white pillar, the office window. Hard shadow.

Mika, a boy of nine, black hair cut in a straight line round his ears, a green duffle coat with sleeves turned back, crouches over one blue chalk tin held flat in his palm. Middle distance: the broom handle in the ground, the taut string, a run of chalk marks. Background: the white pillar, the school wall, low sun.

Mr Raukura, a grey-haired man of sixty-five in a dark suit, stands in a doorway with one handbell in his hand, head slightly bowed. Middle distance: a round white clock with two hands, the white stone pillar and its sundial. Background: the corridor, a door open to the gravel yard, winter daylight.

Mika, a boy of nine, black hair cut in a straight line round his ears, a green duffle coat with sleeves turned back, crouches at the edge of one wide band of blue chalk drawn round the pillar. Middle distance: the sundial's gnomon, a straw broom laid down, gravel. Background: the school wall and gate, late sun. Long hard shadow.

Mika, a boy of nine, black hair cut in a straight line round his ears, a green duffle coat with sleeves turned back, kneels with his own long shadow lying across the wide band of blue chalk, one hand above it. Middle distance: the broom handle, the taut string, a tin of chalk. Background: the white pillar, late sun.
